title: Q-FLEETMAP-did-it-work: ultrastable/did-it-work is not equal to its source (1 file(s) differ, 0 missing, 0 only in the copy)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** fleetmap --drift --apply (daily in tenant-sync.yml)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe did-it-work
**Prediction:** fleet_map_drifted_repos <= 0 within 168 h
**Status:** open

ultrastable/did-it-work is a copy and is not equal to its source (FLEET-MAP-1): 1 file(s) differ, 0 missing, 0 only in the copy.

- differ: lifecycle.json
- ultrastable.json is in the older tenant-standard shape (runs_as as one object, no visibility); the schema is seed/standards/system.schema.json

Fix the sync named in doctrine/fleet-map.json for this repository (never copy by hand), then the same reading closes this item.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe did-it-work


**Out of scope:** editing the copy by hand, changing the source it is copied from, or relaxing the drift reading.
